title: 球队老板亲口说：女篮缺资本，只能靠主动联系破局？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Women's sports, we don't necessarily have the capital. And so for me, a lot of the deals that I've had to make, I have to get creative.
segments.zh: 女子体育，我们不一定有资本。所以对我来说，很多交易我都得创新。

segments.en: And I have to do those cold reach outs. And I have to figure it out because I don't necessarily have the funds to build the empire that I want to build.
segments.zh: 我得主动联系别人，我得想办法，因为我不一定有资金去打造我想要的帝国。

segments.en: But I'm just trying not to let that stop me.
segments.zh: 但我只是努力不让这阻止我。

segments.en: Welcome back to the deal, I'm Jason Kelly. And I'm Alex Rodriguez. All right, Alex, coming up on the show, René Montgomery, the co-owner and vice president of the Atlanta Dream.
segments.zh: 欢迎回到The Deal，我是Jason Kelly。我是Alex Rodriguez。好了，Alex，接下来是Atlanta Dream的联合所有人兼副总裁Renee Montgomery。

segments.en: A player-turned-owner, that sounds familiar. Yes, and we also have the Minnesota League that's in common, where she won two championships for us.
segments.zh: 从球员变成老板，听起来很熟悉。是的，我们还有共同的明尼苏达联盟，她为我们赢得了两个冠军。

segments.en: And I'm really interested to ask her a little bit about how she got into the dream.
segments.zh: 我真的很想问问她是怎么进入Dream的。

segments.en: All right, the deal on the deal, coming up, René Montgomery.
segments.zh: 好了，The Deal的Deal，接下来，Renee Montgomery。

segments.en: René Montgomery, really good to have you here. I got to start with the elephant in the room because I've got the links, and I got the former links
segments.zh: Renee Montgomery，很高兴你能来。我得先问那个显而易见的问题，因为我支持Lynx，以前支持Lynx

segments.en: now the dream. We good? Yeah, everything okay between you guys?
segments.zh: 现在支持Dream。我们没事吧？你们之间一切都好吗？

segments.en: Oh, I saw a love with Minnesota, they know that. So I mean, Minnesota gave me two championships.
segments.zh: 哦，我对明尼苏达有爱，他们知道。明尼苏达给了我两个冠军。

segments.en: I can never be mad at that. Yeah, well, Minnesota is not mad at you either.
segments.zh: 我永远不会为此生气。明尼苏达也没生你的气。

segments.en: I don't think it's that bad. You gave us two championships, we love.
segments.zh: 我觉得没那么糟。你给了我们两个冠军，我们爱你。

segments.en: And we haven't won since, so we have a little work to do. I mean, that was your start.
segments.zh: 之后我们没再赢过，所以还得努力。那是你的起点。

segments.en: I mean, there must be a lot that you think back to a very different WNBA then.
segments.zh: 回想起来，那时的WNBA肯定很不一样。

segments.en: Yeah, I mean, it's a very different WNBA now, but I will say Minnesota was a little bit ahead of the curve.
segments.zh: 是的，现在WNBA很不一样了，但明尼苏达当时有点超前。
